<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 260" width="400" height="260">
  <style>
    @keyframes spin { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    .wheel { animation: spin 1s linear infinite; transform-origin: center; transform-box: fill-box; }
  </style>

  <!-- 地面 -->
  <line x1="0" y1="230" x2="400" y2="230" stroke="#888" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- 后轮 -->
  <g transform="translate(120,190)">
    <g class="wheel">
      <circle r="34" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="5"/>
      <line x1="-34" y1="0" x2="34" y2="0" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="-34" x2="0" y2="34" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <!-- 前轮 -->
  <g transform="translate(280,190)">
    <g class="wheel">
      <circle r="34" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="5"/>
      <line x1="-34" y1="0" x2="34" y2="0" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="-34" x2="0" y2="34" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- 车架 -->
  <path d="M120 190 L200 150 L280 190 M200 150 L200 110 M120 190 L200 110 L180 150"
        fill="none" stroke="#d9534f" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- 车把 -->
  <path d="M200 110 L210 85 L230 80" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- 座椅 -->
  <line x1="185" y1="105" x2="225" y2="105" stroke="#333" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- 鹈鹕 -->
  <g>
    <!-- 腿踩踏板 -->
    <path d="M205 105 L215 140 L205 165" fill="none" stroke="#f4a300" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- 身体 -->
    <ellipse cx="210" cy="80" rx="38" ry="26" fill="#fdfdfd" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- 翅膀 -->
    <path d="M195 78 Q230 70 240 88 Q225 95 200 90 Z" fill="#e8e8e8" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- 脖子 -->
    <path d="M235 70 Q255 55 250 35" fill="none" stroke="#fdfdfd" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- 头 -->
    <circle cx="250" cy="32" r="12" fill="#fdfdfd" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- 眼睛 -->
    <circle cx="254" cy="28" r="2.5" fill="#222"/>
    <!-- 大嘴（鹈鹕标志） -->
    <path d="M258 34 L305 44 L258 46 Q252 40 258 34 Z" fill="#f4a300" stroke="#c77f00" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <path d="M258 44 L300 46 Q280 58 262 50 Z" fill="#e09400"/>
  </g>
</svg>
